governance_task_snapshot: Exact immutable publication SHA supplied in architect launch message; do not use main or a historical task as current
preflight: Confirm remote branch HEAD, direct parent, main and document identities; stop/report a changed target or inaccessible essential material; do not review a moving target
code_access: STRICTLY READ-ONLY; no production/test/spec changes; execute tests only without writing into code tree

architect_probe.classification: Architect triage, not independent reviewer closure or pytest

reading_scope: Read the original four findings and their normative clauses; preserve original review and accepted notes
Read the architect reconciliation and current receipt; read corrective report sections relevant to each finding and their own evidence
Read the actual production paths and changed tests at the pinned final HEAD, using f8416b8..cc903d8 as primary corrective diff; baseline cumulative diff only for allowlist and concrete regressions
Verify full frozen-spec file identity; consult its relevant CP1 clauses/scenarios; do not repeat entire draft/architecture reviews
Read AGENTS/CLAUDE/protocol and current task/STATUS; task role is independent reviewer, not implementer

acceptance: Reproduce numeric-string/integral-float/bool cases and numeric Literal equality cases through real production types
Reproduce all 17 ordinary-string fields: bytes/bytearray by constructor/model_validate, native str controls, three nullable fields and JSON round-trips
Verify field-localized rejection and unchanged valid public JSON/ID/checksum spelling/scientific values; no demand that native int in float field be prohibited without contract basis

findings_to_reverify.scope: T-020A-076/077, interruptions in CP1 adapter phases
acceptance: Read actual phase-injection tests and production calls; KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit separately, same instance and original exit code
Assess actual phase mapping against the frozen CP1 obligation, real BlockLogs/resource unwinding where applicable and no partial result/later execution
No whole-adapter mock or fake scientific result as proof; do not demand future readers/service tests in CP1
LogWarningMsg marker after real return, failure and both interruption types, captured through capfd/subprocess
No EnableLog after operation masking suppression; legacy enumeration tests alone or a second successful calculation are insufficient
Real single-record V3000 bytes, real supplier confirms SGroup/AND/OR retention, real public adapter rejects unsupported-structure
No parser/eligibility monkeypatch faking rejection; preserve scientifically valid positive controls and distinguish parse failure
Synthetic RDKit writer fixtures allowed; do not impose platform-independent byte-identical serialization as a new scientific contract

regression_limits: Only concrete regressions/violations caused or exposed by corrections; do not reopen accepted choices by preference
Preserve M/L/Q SVG grammar and explicit Z rejection, accepted neutral helper placement, scientific APIs/pins/optional boundaries/legacy behavior
Only four cumulative files; only two files in latest commit; adapter production unchanged since original CP1

tests_policy.instruction: Use existing environment where possible, no global installation; do not modify code tree with bytecode/cache. If dependencies unavailable, declare actual limits, do static source review and independent probes where feasible; do not turn supplied results into own execution. Full suite optional if warranted/available, not required to repeat original study.
tests_policy.count_reconciliation: Since first review +108 = 72+18+18; last +18 = 17 parametrized items plus one null test. Confirm mechanically; mark collect-only versus structural count. Original weak log test may be intentionally replaced by stronger proof, not treated as arbitrary deletion.

output_branch_policy: Own authorized claude/ branch, preferably claude/020-a-checkpoint1-focal-reverification-20261026, based on supplied governance release; compatible session branch acceptable if required by environment, identify it explicitly
required_report: Input identities and pinned final HEAD; four-finding disposition CLOSED/OPEN/NOT VERIFIED with normative and file/function/line evidence
Concrete remaining/new BLOCKERS/MAJORS/MINORS/NOTES, separate contract failures from preferences; do not count historical closed findings as remaining
Reconciled counts, source/test/assertion evidence; exact own commands/versions/results versus supplied Windows/full-suite data
Limits of verification; verdict APPROVE / APPROVE WITH NOTES / REQUEST CHANGES and READY FOR OWNER CP2 AUTHORIZATION DECISION YES/NO; no implementation authorization
Output path/lines/bytes/SHA-256, commit/branch and remotely verified publication; report access failure without bypass or false publication claim
prohibited: Editing implementer report or architect central STATUS/tasks
Reopening closed documentary choices by preference
Amending frozen SVG grammar or including Z
PR, merge, formal GitHub approval, comments, force push, amend/reset/rebase, configuration/visibility changes
Updating central STATUS/tasks or editing old reports/evidence; only new review/evidence in allowed outputs
next_gate: Architect reconciles independent result; responsible owner decides any new checkpoint implementation authorization separately
